title: The Fallows' 'Whose Ground' quest promised four claims (surveyor, recruiter, sister, Keeper) but Frey the Keeper's 'leave it fallow' option was only ever offered once, in an early unrelated conversation, and never resurfaced or was recapped alongside the other three when the actual decision needed to be made at the chapel.
